pages.text: Press $(k:key.icys-better-horses.call)$() while mounted to open a full profile of the horse you're riding. Pressing it $(thing)without$() a horse under you still whistles your nearby mount, same as before.

pages.title: What's Shown
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Gender$() and $(thing)Breed$() (with a $(thing)(mix)$() tag if cross-bred).$(li)$(thing)Coat$() — color plus markings.$(li)$(thing)Bond$() — raw value out of 100 with a fill bar.$(li)$(thing)Speed$() — blocks per second.$(li)$(thing)Jump$() — block height.$(li)$(thing)Health$() — hit points.

pages.title: Reading the Bars
pages.text: Every bar starts at zero and fills toward the mod-attainable maximum at full bond:$(br2)$(li)Speed up to $(thing)25.5 blk/s$().$(li)Jump up to $(thing)9.5 blk$().$(li)Health up to $(thing)30 HP$().$(br2)A short bar means the stat has room to grow; bonding closes that gap.
